nodes.name: Get Untagged People
nodes.notes: Hits the Flask API bridge (app/db_api.py) - must be running on localhost:8787. n8n has no built-in SQLite node, this is the portable alternative. Response is a JSON array; n8n auto-splits it into one item per person (verified empirically, no Split Out node needed).

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: "claude-sonnet-4-6", max_tokens: 20, system: "You classify a person's skill set into exactly one category: automation-heavy, web dev, data, voice/calling, or other. Respond with ONLY the category label, nothing else - no punctuation, no explanation.", messages: [{ role: "user", content: "Skills: " + $json.skills_text }] }) }}

nodes.name: Classify Skill Category (Claude)
nodes.notes: REQUIRES SETUP: after importing, open this node -> Authentication -> Header Auth -> create a new credential named 'x-api-key' with your real Anthropic API key as the value. See README for exact steps.

nodes.name: Parse & Validate Category
nodes.notes: mode is explicitly 'runOnceForEachItem' - the default mode ('runOnceForAllItems') silently drops every item except the first when the code returns a single object instead of an array. Caught this during testing: only 1/55 people got tagged before this fix. See stuck log.
